## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector returns (Energy/Materials/Industrials leading while Technology/Financials lag) and broad leadership across 4 sectors in the top performers — suppress strong directional calls.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: OXY (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +2.65% | 1M: +12.26%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: FCX (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +12.37%) ABOVE TREND, NUE (+65 sentiment) supporting the theme. Industrials showing strength: DE (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +25.29%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging overall (1W: -1.10% | 24 stocks) with MSFT (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -16.32%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -5.40% | 1M: -36.40%) BELOW TREND and ACN (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -30.01%) BELOW TREND. Financials soft (1W: -1.89% | 20 stocks) with JPM (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND and V (1W: -3.84% | 1M: -5.62%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate weak (1W: -1.09% | 10 stocks) and shows headline sensitivity.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PYPL (1W: +15.22% | 1M: -16.96%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +12.37%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +25.29%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) — cyclical/value tilt.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: CVS (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -10.64%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -23.10%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -5.40% | 1M: -36.40%) BELOW TREND, USB (1W: -5.40% | 1M: -0.79%) BELOW TREND, TXN (1W: -5.47% | 1M: +11.09%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in several large-cap techs and select financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Largest 1W momentum: PYPL (1W: +15.22% | 1M: -16.96%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +12.37%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +25.29%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE: several big-cap names (AMD, AMZN, GOOGL, PYPL, TTWO) show 1W up vs 1M down — tactical bounces, watch for confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed and under pressure: AAPL (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +9.82%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +4.26% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND vs MSFT (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -16.32%) BELOW TREND and INTU (1W: -5.40% | 1M: -36.40%) BELOW TREND — dispersion across mega-cap leaders; sector 1W -1.10%.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Fragile and mixed: CME (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +12.84%) ABOVE TREND and PYPL (1W: +15.22% | 1M: -16.96%) RECOVERY offset by JPM (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -4.58% | 1M: -5.10%) BELOW TREND — sector 1W -1.89% and breadth shows internal rotation.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Shallow positive tone: JNJ (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +11.87%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (+60 sentiment) supportive while UNH (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -23.10%) BELOW TREND drags — monitor trial/regulatory headlines; sector 1W +0.05%.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclical/value exposures tied to Energy, Materials and Industrials (OXY, FCX, DE) and reduce exposure to structurally weak large-cap techs showing sustained 1M weakness (MSFT, INTU, ACN). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt given leadership and sector returns, but keep positions tactical due to major divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: PYPL (1W: +15.22% | 1M: -16.96%) RECOVERY on acquisition buzz, OXY (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +5.50% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND on EUV news. BEARISH: UNH (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -23.10%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -5.40% | 1M: -36.40%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -30.01%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.62%) and Materials (1W: +1.01%) — headline-driven rallies. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.10%) and Financials (1W: -1.89%) — watch for continued 1M weakness and earnings/credit headlines.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch for confirmation of 1M trend resumption in cyclical leaders (DE, FCX, OXY) and failure to hold recent 1W gains in RECOVERY names (PYPL, AMD, AMZN) as a trigger to reduce exposure; monitor NVDA/AAPL for renewed upside to validate broad market participation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
PYPL (+80): acquisition rumors; price RECOVERY (1W: +15.22% | 1M: -16.96%) — sentiment confirmed short-term but monitor follow-through. ASML (+80): EUV breakthrough; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.50% | 1M: +7.97%) — confirming accumulation. WMT (+80): buyback headline; price CORRECTION (1W: -1.63% | 1M: +7.66%) — bullish news but short-term weakness (trend exhaustion).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (-55): Novo price cuts headline; price RECOVERY (1W: +0.59% | 1M: -1.92%) — bearish news diverging from short-term lift. DE (-50): weaker 2026 outlook; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +25.29%) — negative headline versus strong price, watch for earnings revisions. WBD (-60): Warner/Netflix deal uncertainty; price showing mixed action — sentiment aligns with headline volatility.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt. OXY (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +12.37%) ABOVE TREND and DE (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +25.29%) ABOVE TREND showing strength. Key risk: major divergence across large caps (multiple RECOVERY names vs multi-week tech/financial weakness) and headline-driven name-specific risk (PYPL, DE, LLY).
